note: Frozen BEFORE any v3 evaluation run. All thresholds and decision rules are a priori or chosen on the 20% training prefix; no evaluation-window tuning. Sweeps on evaluation windows are labelled sensitivity, never selection.

primary_metric.name: pooled_macro_f1
primary_metric.definition: concatenate y_true and y_pred over all evaluation windows of one (dataset, method, seed) run, then macro-F1
primary_metric.secondary: per_window_macro_f1 (mean of per-window macro-F1); always labelled secondary; never mixed with pooled in one table

hypothesis_decision_rule.rule: SUPPORTED only if the block-bootstrap 95% CI (24 day-blocks for UGR'16, regime-visit blocks otherwise) of the paired difference excludes zero in the predicted direction; NOT SUPPORTED otherwise; INCONCLUSIVE when blocks are too few
hypothesis_decision_rule.seed_floor: seed-level exact Wilcoxon over 5 seeds has minimum two-sided p = 0.0625; when a verdict rests on this floor it is stated

label_delay.ugr16: not applicable (labels are not next-window targets)
